# Version 4.150.1
> **Skia m150 engine fixes** · Released July 14, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.1) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.1)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.150.1/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.1 brings two upstream correctness fixes to the m150 engine. It fixes corrupt serialized text handling and stencil-area validation for clipped render passes.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Corrupt serialized text is handled safely** — Corrects destruction ordering in the GPU text allocator to prevent use-after-free and double-free behavior when a corrupt Slug buffer is rejected. ([#4379](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4379))
- **Clipped render-pass stencil bounds are validated** — Includes the upstream m150 fix that checks clipped render-pass bounds against the cleared stencil area. ([#4429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4429))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.1

Ships HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.1 alongside the SkiaSharp 4.150.1 servicing release.
